mathematics.assertion_tested: Covariance kernel is an orthogonal rank-v projector; exact diagonal and reversal identities; feedback unitarity; protected-mark marginal trajectory law.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Q(i) with exact Fraction arithmetic; Q for combinatorial probabilities.
mathematics.conventions: C_(ij),(kl)=sum_e S_ie S_ej conjugate(S_ke S_el), q=w/(1-S_ee w); ordered labels retain identity.
inputs: One prescribed rational complex unitary at each n=2,3,4,5, generated by all-pair rational unitary rotations.
Six rational circle phases, every port.
Protected-mark deletion prefixes enumerated at N=3..7, u=2..N and 1<=marks<=min(4,u).
non_claims: Does not prove the analytic asymptotic theorem.
Does not check the upstream trajectory proof.
No physical BGS claim, no exhaustive coverage of all unitary matrices.
